song.author: Stuart David Garrard
song.title: Sing To The Lord With All Of Your Heart
song.lyrics:
[V1] .E Asus Sing to the Lord with all of your heart. .E D B Sing of the glory that's due to His name. .E Asus Sing to the Lord with all of your soul. .E D B Join all of heaven and earth to proclaim:
[C1] . E A You are the Lord, the Savior of all. . F#m A B God of creation, we praise You. . E A We sing the songs that awaken the dawn. . F#m B E God of creation, we praise You.
[V2] .E Asus Sing to the Lord with all of your mind. .E D B With understanding, give thanks to the King. .E Asus Sing to the Lord with all of your strength, .E D B Living our lives as a praise offering.
